content1.content: A "note app" is a mobile application designed for taking, storing, and managing notes, usually in the form of text, images, or audio. These apps can be used for various purposes, including keeping memos, to-do lists, school notes, and more. Many note apps also offer features like syncing, collaboration, and organizing notes into folders or notebooks.

content4.content: In this project, we are focusing only on the UI.
